svg.title: Lem Fulgencio — Full Stack Developer
svg.desc: Design, Develop, Deploy. The dotted hands from Creation of Adam frame the name. In the Bytebug Battle arena below, Lem walks around carrying a blushing Bytebug. The other Bytebugs wander, bump into each other and react with random emotions, and every 15 seconds one of them begs Lem to carry it instead.
